draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 119th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 12th of 22 at LB. He lasted until pick 177, well after his grade rank (119th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 26 tackles in 2020, 21st of 22 LBs in his class with stats.
